- Atelectasis was described as subsegmental and possibly related to scarring.
- Lung lesions including a midlung nodule and a hemithorax mass were reported.
- A fracture with callus was found at the left ninth lateral rib.
- Pleural effusion was explicitly stated as absent in all relevant findings.
